items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

ctx.x: I can remember all the lights and all the beautiful people. I remember so many, I remember Lena, watching her make up her face, and saying when I get big I want to be like her. I remember, oh, I can’t think of her name you just said it — Carmen?
No, as a child I think, Dinah Washington —
